results.response:
WITH scenario_latencies AS (
    SELECT 
        er.scenario_id,
        AVG(er.latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms
    FROM evaluation_results er
    GROUP BY er.scenario_id
),
ranked_scenarios AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_latency_ms DESC) as rank_num
    FROM scenario_latencies
)
SELECT 
    rs.scenario_id,
    ROUND(rs.avg_latency_ms::numeric, 2) as avg_latency_ms
FROM ranked_scenarios rs
WHERE rs.rank_num <= 5;
